children: Canada digital business bank's Q3 revenue rose 23% yr/yr, net income up 53%
Adjusted (core) net income grew 27% yr/yr, reflecting SRP portfolio expansion
Q3 results include $3.1 mln in non-core non-interest expenses tied to reorganization, software write-off
VersaBank targets at least US$3 bln in new US SRP fundings in fiscal 2027
Company expects accelerated SRP growth in Canada following launch of Real-Time SRP
VersaBank expects to drive further efficiency through broader implementation of AI
SRP EXPANSION - Co said continued growth in Structured Receivable Program portfolios in US and Canada drove record credit assets and revenue
REAL-TIME SRP LAUNCH - Launch of Real-Time SRP generated incremental demand from existing and new partners, especially in US
OPERATING LEVERAGE - Co said branchless, digital model and broader AI implementation are driving efficiency gains and improved risk profile
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the banks peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Versabank is C$26.00, about 1.7% below its September 2 closing price of C$26.44
The stock recently traded at 13 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 13 three months ago
Sept 2 - Bank of Canada holds key rate, says multiple hikes might be needed
